card.fires_on: Verbs and small words right after a person or group as subject, mostly in general web prose, such as 'they say', 'calls for', 'was amazed', 'I'd just'. Also some name endings after a speaker's name.

card.writes: It seems to suppress review and comment words, so it lowers the chance that the next words talk about reviewing or commenting.
card.plain: It fires on the verb after someone who says, asks or feels something, and holds back review-and-comment wording.
